title: Ready?
description: Oura signed England footballers Harry Kane and Declan Rice as global ambassadors for an integrated campaign teasing their World Cup readiness — splashed across Piccadilly Circus and Canary Wharf digital OOH, plus primetime TV around match windows. First time Oura has fronted a campaign with elite male athletes instead of wellness-influencer types.
